name: Be Our Guest: Grand Opening
source:
Have you ever found yourself exhausted and confused by the hustle and bustle of corporate life in the big city?

Wouldn’t it be wonderful if there were a place you could just relax and unwind, maybe have a nice cup of coffee or a snack, in the company of a variety of attentive pink-feathered waterfowl (and also Kenneth)?

Need an opportunity to just hang out and be unafraid to be yourself?

If the answer to any of this is no, then it should be yes, and if the answer to any of this is yes, then you’re welcome to Be Our Guest at the Matinee Cabaret, a fun and inviting café, just a little off the beaten path, and with live entertainment too! Pop in for the grand opening in this charming visual mini-novel featuring original, dynamic spritework and colorful backgrounds for the various locations in the café, where you can meet and chat up the employees through their voice-acted branching dialogue trees. Order a drink, make a friend, solve a dilemma, and preview what the Matinee Cabaret has in store!

[From [url=https://morninchai.itch.io/be-our-guest-grand-opening]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是否曾因大城市喧嚣的企业生活而感到疲惫和困惑？

如果有一个地方可以让你放松身心，也许可以喝杯咖啡或吃点小吃，并与各种细心的粉红色羽毛水鸟（还有肯尼斯）在一起，那不是很棒吗？

需要一个闲逛的机会并且不害怕做你自己吗？

如果任何一个问题的答案是否定的，那么它应该是肯定的，如果任何一个问题的答案是肯定的，那么欢迎你来到Matinee Cabaret做我们的客人，这是一家有趣而诱人的咖啡馆，就在人迹罕至的地方，还有现场娱乐表演！这部迷人的视觉迷你小说的盛大开幕式以原创、动态的精灵作品和咖啡馆各个地点的多彩背景为特色，你可以通过配音分支对话树与员工见面并聊天。点一杯饮料，结交朋友，解决难题，并预览Matinee Cabaret的表演！

[来自[url=https://morninchai.itch.io/be-our-guest-grand-opening]Itch.io[/url]]
